description: This file contains a test suite for the 'runHeartbeatOnce' function, testing its behavior when the last delivery target differs. It uses vitest for testing, imports configuration, utility functions, and the function under test. The test sets up a heartbeat configuration, seeds related session data, and verifies that the message is sent to the correct Slack channel or user.

methods.description: Sets up test runtime environment for heartbeat runner tests.

methods.name: seedMainSessionStore
methods.description: Seeds the session store with initial data for testing.

methods.description: Provides a temporary sandbox environment for heartbeat tests.

methods.name: runHeartbeatOnce
methods.description: Executes a single heartbeat process based on provided configuration and dependencies.
